name: Castelite Company
text: Army marker for the Castelite Company. Its battle trait, regiment abilities and enhancements are listed on the army.

name: The Officer's Order
text: At the start of each battle round, set one battle tactic card from your hand aside face-down. Using its command is free and returns the card to your hand instead of discarding it; it may still be scored as a tactic.

name: For Sigmar, Charge!
text: Friendly Cavalry units that made a charge move this turn have Strike-first.

name: Ironweld Discipline
text: Once per turn in the enemy shooting phase, roll a dice for your Ironweld Great Cannon. On a 3+ it may use its Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase.

name: Flask of Lethisian Darkwater
text: Once per battle, at the start of any turn, heal the bearer for D6.

name: Heirloom Blade
text: The bearer's Master-forged Longsword has +1 Rend.

name: Brazier of Holy Flame
text: At the end of any turn, pick a friendly Freeguild Steelhelms unit within the bearer's combat range and return up to D3 slain models to it.

name: Glimmering
text: Once in each phase, you may re-roll one hit roll, one wound roll or one save roll made for the bearer.

name: Decisive Commander
text: In your hero phase, pick a friendly Freeguild Steelhelms unit wholly within 12" and roll a dice. On a 2+ choose one. On Your Feet!: if the target is not in combat, return D3 slain models to it. Yield No Quarter!: the target has +3 control score until the start of your next turn.

modes.name: On Your Feet!
modes.text: If the target is not in combat, return D3 slain models to it.

modes.name: Yield No Quarter!
modes.text: The target has +3 control score until the start of your next turn.

name: Consecrate the Land
text: In your movement phase, if this unit alone holds an objective you control, roll a dice. On a 3+ the objective becomes consecrated for you: your units contesting it have Ward (6+) until the enemy takes control of it.

name: Devastating Charge
text: In any charge phase, if this unit charged, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a dice. On a 2+ the target suffers D3 mortal damage.

name: Shot and Shell
text: Whenever this unit shoots, choose Cannonball or Grapeshot for all its Great Cannon attacks. Cannonball cannot be chosen if the unit has used a Move ability this turn.
